target_claims.statement: Every nontrivial zero rho of the classical Riemann zeta function satisfies Re(rho)=1/2.

inputs: Retrospective theorem ledger, exact zeta normalization, and dependency-debt gate.
checker_contract.acceptance: Admit a later claim only with exact quantifiers, normalization, complete proof or finite certificate scope, and independent replay.
checker_contract.rejection: Reject finite-height checks, equivalent-criterion samples, density statements, or statistical evidence as RH.

claim_boundary: This pending packet registers RH-T-000 and its burden; it proves no new zero range and does not prove the Riemann Hypothesis.

reopening_conditions: Reopen after native migration and production of a precise proof or finite certificate packet.
